usage.callShape: POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/images/generations with JSON body {model:"openai/gpt-image-1", prompt}; then poll-GET the returned poll_url (each poll is its own x402 paid call)
usage.outputShape: POST: body.id + body.poll_url (status queued). Final result after polling: body.data[0].url (PNG image URL); body.status=="completed"; body.payment.tx_hash for settlement
quirks: Async: POST returns 202 with status:queued and a relative poll_url (/api/v1/images/generations/<id>) — the image is NOT in the POST response.

Poll endpoint enforces its OWN x402 402 challenge, wallet-bound. Each GET poll must carry a fresh x-payment header signed by the SAME wallet that did the POST, and EACH POLL COSTS ANOTHER PAYMENT (~$0.021). Total observed cost = POST $0.021 + 1 poll $0.021 = $0.042.
A fresh signature works (server enforces wallet binding, not signature byte-equality), so standard x402 clients re-sign automatically on the 402.
Result image URL is at body.data[0].url; settlement tx_hash appears on the completed poll under body.payment.tx_hash.
usage.guide: POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/images/generations with JSON {"model":"openai/gpt-image-1","prompt":"<your prompt>"} and pay the ~$0.021 x402 charge on Base USDC. The response is a 202 queued job with an id and a relative poll_url. Then GET the poll_url with the same x402 wallet — the poll endpoint returns its own 402 challenge, so each poll is a SEPARATE paid call (~$0.021); budget for at least one extra payment. Poll until status=="completed", then read the image at body.data[0].url. The whole job typically costs ~$0.042 (POST + one completing poll).
